module Greeter
import StdEnv

/* outer /* nested */ still a comment */
:: Shape = Circle Real | Rect Real Real

area :: Shape -> Real
area (Circle r) = 3.14 * r * r
area (Rect w h) = w * h

Start :: String
Start = "Hello, Clean! " +++ toString (area (Circle 1.5)) +++ toString 'x' +++ toString True
